methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This article presents a six-sigma based energy management planning procedure, focusing on five major steps: define, measure, analyze, improve, and control.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a six-sigma (DMAIC) energy management planning framework/procedure (energy team, energy audits, generic saving-opportunity identification, DOE-tool savings estimation, payback calculation, monitoring). No EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised: no normalisation variables, no functional form, no construction/estimation approach for an energy performance indicator or baseline.

paper_type.evidence_quote: This article focuses on the use of the six-sigma approach in energy management planning.

stage1.notes: Context 'oil equipment and service industries' = discrete Louisiana IAC manufacturers, not refining; level_3b false regardless. paper_type: framework vs methodological/theoretical is a borderline call.
